hero.title: We built Sanaa because Gaza deserves it
hero.desc: Sanaa was launched as a bridge connecting the wisdom of the trades and the authenticity of handcraft with the latest digital escrow technology, to restore dignity to every hand that toils with pride and empower thousands of creators to bring life and reconstruction back to our communities.
hero.standardsDesc: Every registered craftsman goes through an on-site assessment and certified verification

vm.title: Our Vision & Mission
vm.subtitle: We work every day to establish a pioneering model that restores craftsmen to their central place in economic and enriching development.

mission.title: Empowering craftsmen, comforting customers
mission.desc: We seek to empower local craft talent and provide a platform that showcases their skills, while making it easy for customers to reach reliable, high-quality services within seconds.

vision.title: The first destination for craftsmen
vision.desc: To become the leading and most trusted digital community in the Middle East for professional services, where excellence meets trust and innovation.

values.title: Our firm values that govern every transaction
values.subtitle: We are not just a technical intermediary; we establish solid ethical standards that ensure lasting trust between the craftsman and the customer.

quality.title: Excellence and integrity
quality.desc: We treat the quality of work as a sacred duty, verifying every delivery to ensure it meets the agreed construction and engineering specifications.

community.title: Empowering the local community
community.desc: Investing in craftsmen skills and providing continuous financial and training support for young people and women to open up independent freelance opportunities.

transparency.title: Transparency and guarantee
transparency.desc: Escrow accounts protect all project parties until the work is fully completed and the customer is satisfied, with no surprises or disputes.

heritage.title: Sustaining identity and heritage
heritage.desc: Protecting authentic trades from disappearing and documenting rare skills in woodcarving, plasterwork, artisanal fanlights and building protection.

join.title: Are you a craftsman or contractor looking for quality opportunities?
join.desc: Join a certified network that ensures you get paid on time and opens the door to the biggest projects.

final.title: Be part of the journey to revive craftsmanship and make an impact
final.desc: Whether you want to renovate an old house, carry out skilled construction work, or support dedicated workers, Sanaa is your safe destination.
